results.title: Andaman tourism industry facing challenges and setbacks - Facebook
results.content: Port Blair, July 25: Andaman tourism industry has been suffering from a major setback since past few years, starting with Tourist Boat Tragedy of 2014 wherein 22 lives were lost within hours. Any and all decisions regarding tourism in the islands should be done in consultation with the stakeholders. It is we the stakeholders who have been promoting the tourism in the islands and not the Administration”, voiced M Vinod, President of Andaman Association of Tour Operators. In the name of tourism, the authorities only impose rules, he said adding that there is no harm in making rules for safety and convenience of tourists but it should not lead to closure of the industry in the islands. Bharat Sharma from the Island Tourist Boat Operators Association expressed that there is no support by the Administration to develop tourism in the islands. Earlier there was no much involvement of officials in the tourism sector but after the boat tragedy, all the departments of A&N Administration have started taking decisions.
